480:t_020:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I have to report to $$アウストラリス$$, so I'll leave the rest to you.」

480:t_021:0.en:
$$葵$$
「She left without even saying goodbye to you, $$ランド$$.」

480:t_021:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「That just shows how much your hit hurt her.」

480:t_021:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「No, $$ランド・トラビス$$! Lady $$エルーナ$$ has lost interest in you!」

480:t_021:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Silence! Do you intend to spurn Lady $$エルーナ$$'s affection?!」

480:t_021:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then what the hell am I supposed to do?!」

480:t_021:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Let me slay you here! That is your destiny!」

480:t_021:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Would you stop getting carried away by yourself, $$ダバラーン$$?」

480:t_021:8.en:
$$くらら$$
「Sorry, but we're the stars of the show today.」

480:t_021:9.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Your job is to make us look good.」

480:t_021:10.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「So, we'll have you become rust on the Dankuuken.」

480:t_021:11.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Are you ready to meet your end?」

480:t_021:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Th-this aura...! It's just like Lady $$エルーナ$$'s...」

480:t_021:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Right? So $$葵$$ will take you on.」

480:t_021:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Grrr, come at me! I'll prove that the likes of you can't hold a candle to Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

480:t_021:16.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Go, $$葵$$! Defeat the enemy commander, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$, and settle this battle!」

480:t_022:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Grrr! I have a duty to escort Lady $$エルーナ$$ to $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

480:t_022:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Lady $$エルーナ$$! I am coming to join you!」

480:t_023:0.en:
$$朔哉$$
「...Jeez. He should just admit he lost.」

480:t_023:1.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「That must be the result of his pride mingling with his affection for $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

480:t_023:2.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「He has a cute side, doesn't he?」

480:t_023:3.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Is that how you see it?」

480:t_024:1.en:
$$葵$$
(Thank you, Senpai... Thanks to you... we won...)

480:t_024:2.en:
$$葵$$
(I wonder if we've gotten a little closer to you now...)

480:t_024:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Brilliant work, $$チームＤ$$. The strongest team in history indeed. You are worthy of inheriting the $$ダンクーガ$$ name.」

480:t_025:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「So you sensed my presence, $$マーズ$$.」

480:t_025:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Last time, you said you would bring $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

480:t_025:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「He will not come here. I shall guide you to him.」

480:t_025:7.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Blood of the beast...」

480:t_025:9.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「...Mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire, and then the sun's radiance lead humanity down the path of $$シンカ$$...」

480:t_025:10.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「But your destination is not the sun's radiance. It is the deepest darkness.」

480:t_026:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「$$マーズ$$... And $c. I shall invite you into darkness.」

480:t_027:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's keep going, guns blazing, $$ガンレオン$$!」

480:t_028:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice work! You beat the elite of $$ハイアデス$$!」

480:t_028:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Just so you know, we aren't done! You're next!」

480:t_028:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm so happy, darling! You've finally gotten in the mood!」

480:t_028:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up! I'll shut that smart mouth of yours for good!」

480:t_029:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Damn it! The elite of $$ハイアデス$$ have fallen?!」

480:t_029:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Just you wait, $$ダバラーン$$! You're next!」

480:t_029:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I won't allow it! Don't underestimate the power of Lady $$エルーナ$$'s right hand, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$!」

480:t_100:0.en:
$$葵$$
(What is this...? This heat in my body... It's like when we went to $$パラダイムシティ$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$...)

480:t_100:1.en:
$$葵$$
(What's happening to me...? Could this be the effect of $$ゲッター線$$...?)

480:t_101:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, darling! Let's have some real fun!」

480:t_101:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Listen, $$エルーナルーナ$$! If you're a human and not a beast, listen when people talk to you!」

480:t_101:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Beast, human, who cares? I just do whatever I want, whenever I want, as much as I want!」

480:t_101:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That makes you a beast through and through!」

480:t_101:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's fine, darling! You should become a beast, too, and enjoy yourself to the fullest!」

480:t_101:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「A death match between a golden bull and a lion! This is the best!」

480:t_102:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「How have you been, $n?! I'll test how much stronger you've gotten since then!」

480:t_102:1.en:
$n
「So you're targeting me as well as $$ランド$$?!」

480:t_102:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Too bad! Believe it or not, I'm a one-man woman.」

480:t_102:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「$$アムブリエル$$ will be your partner! So today, I'm just having a taste!」

480:t_102:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You should give up already. They'll fuse soon, and the Miss $$スズネ$$ you love will disappear completely.」

480:t_102:6.en:
$n
「I won't let that happen...! Like hell I will!」

480:t_103:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then I, $$ダバラーン$$, shall carry out His Majesty's command in Lady $$エルーナ$$'s place!」

480:t_103:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even $$エルーナルーナ$$ couldn't win! What makes you think you can?!」

480:t_103:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I shall! For Lady $$エルーナ$$'s sake!」

480:t_103:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't hate a guy who gives his all for the woman he loves!」

480:t_103:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「But I won't show mercy to someone who drags other people into a fight for it!」

480:t_103:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Here I come, $$ダバラーン$$! Today, I'm fighting with the power of love, too!」

480:t_103:6.en:
$$葵$$
「And I'll cleave that evil space! With the shining fang I inherited from Senpai!!」

480:t_104:0.en:
$$葵$$
(I'll do it, Senpai...! We will inherit the $$ダンクーガ$$ name!)
